card.name: Verbs and words before 'each year'
card.fires_on: The verb or word right after a statistic about how many people, babies or animals are affected, where 'each year', 'every year' or 'annually' is expected next. It also fires on 'each' or 'every' itself just before 'year'.

modes.label: Verb after a count
modes.description: A passive or event verb such as born, occur or killed follows a large number, and a yearly rate comes next.
modes.example: Four million babies are<< born>> in the United States each year, and

modes.label: Each/every before year
modes.description: The word 'each' or 'every' sits right before 'year' in a yearly-rate statement.
modes.example: some 1,500 babies<< each>> year. 2 Spina bifida

card.writes: It pushes the model to produce yearly-rate words such as annually, yearly and 每年.
card.plain: It spots a statistic where the text is about to say how many happen per year.
